results.title: Safe Space
results.overview: A troubled young girl embarks on a journey to the Moon in her homemade rocket, where she explores its surface alongside her hero: Neil Armstrong.

results.title: Mothballs
results.overview: Something is bugging Brian Berger, and all of his work obligations certainly aren’t helping.

Trapped in a run-down circus, actress @A is forced to watch another prisoner, @B, on a monitor. As vicious social media attacks against @A intensify her nightmare, @B desperately tries to communicate about a disturbing clown painting. Caught between reality and delusion, @A must unravel the connection between the two to fight for her sanity and survival.

results.title: Fish & Chips
results.overview: Fab plans a surprise for Cassie on their first anniversary, but Cassie's rough day, coupled with a party popper mishap, leads to a heated argument over dinner options. What starts as a takeaway tiff over Caribbean or pizza spirals into an identity battle, revealing deep-seated resentments about their racial and queer identities. With half of the film shot in one take, Fish and Chips is a tender, unflinching exploration of mixed-heritage identity, queer love, and the fine line between connection and conflict.

results.title: Four Rivers Six Ranges: The Untold Story of Tibet
results.original_title: Four Rivers Six Ranges: The Untold Story of Tibet
results.overview: 4 Rivers 6 Ranges is based on the book “Flight at the Cuckoos Behest”  by Dorjee Wangdi Dewatshang

results.title: Youri
results.overview: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

results.title: Transfer Trimurthulu
results.overview: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

results.title: Silent Flood
results.overview: Set by a beautiful river canyon in Western Ukraine, a pacifist community with unique religious beliefs, sees their peaceful way of life gradually distressed by regular floods and eventually an unexpected war.

results.title: Cradled
results.overview: When an overprotective mother grieving her husband's death prepares to tell her son the truth after he arrives home from college, her inability to face the dark reality invites a haunting presence into their home.

results.title: Evi
results.overview: A famous singer loses everything when her label drops her without pay. With help from her best friend and manager, she struggles to rebuild her career and find herself again.

results.title: Asphalt Guerrilla
results.overview: A reserved student joins a radical organization in early 1980s Portugal and is shot and lynched following a bank robbery, while a filmmaker leaves the group to pursue guerrilla-style cinema.

results.title: We Took A Train
results.overview: A travel vlogger persuades his friend to embark on a 36-hour journey aboard the Amtrak Coast Starlight, hoping the trip will finally bring them closer.

results.title: A Moment in her Life
results.overview: A young actress is preparing for an important audition while caring for her father, who suffers from Parkinson’s disease. As his condition deteriorates, the line between desire and duty begins to blur.

results.title: Parallel Gazes
results.overview: Three young adults who dream of becoming gangsters face a series of obstacles during their first heist.

results.title: Le Grand Virage
results.overview: On the track at the Bretagne Velodrome, Nahel and Lauryne, two 16-year-old athletes, are training for the French Championships. They dream of a place on the podium and of recognition.

results.title: The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift
results.overview: Between 2001 and 2010, separated by thousands of miles, the victims shared one connection: they were all associated with Hooters. The Hooters Murders: Deadly Shift is a two-hour documentary that unravels these tragic murders, exposing how young women who were linked to the iconic restaurant chain were preyed upon.
